description: One wallet's Predict.fun fills, newest first, each with its market (`market_id`, `market_title`) and `outcome`; otherwise the rows of predictfun_market_trades. Returns {trades, next_cursor}. One row is one ORDER's fill, not one match: a match is a `maker` row per resting order hit plus one `taker` row for the order that took them (whose amounts are theirs added up), so add `usd` over ONE role, never both.

address.description: The wallet, 0x and 40 hex digits. Required.

cursor.description: A previous page's `next_cursor`, unchanged, to read the next page.

name: predictfun_wallet_trades
title: Predict.fun Wallet Trades
